title: Author the shared build-type interview guide
description: Create .agent/plan-interview.md containing the full interview script: Phase A universal triage (four one-at-a-time questions ending in a build-type classifier), Phase B deep-dive tracks for Game / CLI tool / App / Library plus a generic fallback, and the synthesis + confirm-back section that maps answers onto requirements.json fields (summary, goals, features, constraints) and a first-draft task-plan.json. Written agent-agnostically so Claude Code and Codex can both run it.
acceptance_criteria: .agent/plan-interview.md exists with Phase A, Phase B (4 tracks + generic fallback), and synthesis/confirm-back sections.
Each Phase B track lists concrete questions and names the requirements.json field(s) it feeds.
The guide instructs the agent to confirm proposed requirements.json and task-plan.json with the operator before writing, and to stop for human approval before plan seed.
